title: P1-9r verify-15-gates: Expand verify to enumerate master §63's 15 named verification gates
description: Feature P1-9r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-sqmov). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original 'no gate attribution' framing was inaccurate. The verify subcommand at crates/vb_cli/src/commands_verify.rs:73-122 already produces a `checks: Vec<&'static str>` with 5-6 named checks (yaml_parse, compilation, ir_validation, budget_computation, boundedness_policy, boundedness_policy_check). The real gap is that master §63 specifies 15 named verification gates and verify only covers 6 of them. The fix is to expand the check set to all 15 §63 gates, ensuring no collision with the section codes used elsewhere (avoid the `0x0E01..0x0F01` collision). Real source: commands_verify.rs:73-122 (the check list), master doc §63 (the 15-gate spec). The 9 missing gates (gates 7-15) are: (7) digest_stability (workflow digest is deterministic), (8) resource_contract_validation (ResourceContract::DEFAULT vs explicit), (9) error_handler_completeness (every error-prone node has an on_error), (10) taint_boundary (no Secret in Finish, no Secret in Save), (11) input_purity (no mutation of input slots), (12) expression_complexity (ExprOp count within bound), (13) cycle_detection (no cycles in dependency graph), (14) determinism_seed (no SystemTime::now() in user code), (15) replay_round_trip (compile→snapshot→recover→snapshot is bit-identical). Also: add an explicit `#[derive(kani::Arbitrary)]` impl for `VerifyOk` (or its result struct) so Kani can prove the gate attribution. Master §63 is authoritative; the 15-gate numbering is the spec.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL enumerate all 15 verification gates from master §63 in the verify subcommand output
THE SYSTEM SHALL use distinct 4-hex-digit gate codes (0x0E01..0x0F0F) that do not collide with the 0x0E01..0x0F01 range used by other section codes

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb verify <workflow.yaml> --profile full`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL output a VerifyOk with a `checks` array of length 15, each entry being the gate name and a 4-hex-digit code

unwanted.condition: IF a gate is not applicable to the workflow (e.g., digest_stability on a 0-node workflow)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently drop the gate; it must report it as 'not_applicable' with a reason
unwanted.because: Master §63 requires the full 15-gate enumeration, not a dynamic subset

verify at commands_verify.rs:73-122 already produces a 5-6 entry checks list; we extend it to 15

kani::Arbitrary impl for VerifyOk is added (or a wrapper struct) so Kani can prove gate attribution
invariants: The 15 gate codes are stable across runs (deterministic; no SystemTime::now() in code attribution)
The 15 gate codes are distinct from each other and from the 0x0E01..0x0F01 range used by other sections
